name: Ridgeline Adjustable Weighted Training Vest
description: A low-profile plate-carrier style training vest built for rucking, hill sprints, bodyweight circuits and outdoor conditioning. The heavy-duty nylon shell features MOLLE-style webbing, padded mesh-lined shoulders and wraparound adjustable side straps so the load stays close to your torso and moves with you instead of bouncing. A reinforced top grab handle makes it easy to throw on between sets.

name: Trailhead Home Strength Kit
description: Everything you need for a full-body session at home, in the garage or at the park. The kit pairs a set of compact, coated hand dumbbells with a resistance band featuring padded foam handles and secure clip anchors. Use it for presses, rows, curls, banded pulls and mobility work, then pack it away in seconds. Ideal for travel days and quick morning workouts.

name: Summit Roll-Top Waterproof Gear Backpack
description: A weatherproof roll-top backpack made for wet trails, lake days, rainy commutes and gym-to-field transitions. The water-resistant coated shell, sealed roll-top closure and front zip pocket keep your gear protected, while breathable mesh shoulder straps, an adjustable sternum strap and a padded back panel keep heavy loads comfortable from trailhead to summit.
